name: Urabrask
aliases: the praetor of the Quiet Furnace
description: Urabrask is the Phyrexian praetor of the Quiet Furnace, who leads the red-aligned faction of New Phyrexia and refuses to serve Elesh Norn.

summary.text: Urabrask is the Phyrexian praetor of the Quiet Furnace, who leads the red-aligned faction of New Phyrexia and refuses to serve Elesh Norn.

bio.text: He is the one praetor who does not take part in compleating the captured Mirran angel Atraxa alongside Elesh Norn and the others.

citations.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citations.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

bio.text: On New Capenna, Tezzeret leads Vivien to the wounded Urabrask in a cavern below the city, where Urabrask says he serves no one, will not give Norn the Quiet Furnace, and will lead a challenge to her control.

citations.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.
"The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

bio.text: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for him in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and he asks her to find Elspeth, whom Norn fears.

citations.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

bio.text: Vivien later passes word of his planned revolution to Elspeth and tells the group on Dominaria that he opposes Elesh Norn.

bio.text: His domain is hidden from Tezzeret's Darksteel Eye, and he allows the Mirrans to live in the Furnace Layer while leading a rebellion hoped to distract Norn.

citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.
timeline.quote: "Good, come along then. Urabrask will be eager to meet you."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
timeline.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Elspeth of Urabrask's planned revolution on New Phyrexia, and they decide to take the Halo and the news to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "Dominaria." Elspeth turned away from the city skyline of New Capenna.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
timeline.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
timeline.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
timeline.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: She then became the Mother of Machines, the highest power in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Victorious". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn tries to compleat a Mirran woman, but the compleation fails because of a nightmare produced by Ashiok; Norn vows to kill Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Enraged, Norn vowed she would kill Elspeth

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Meeting Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn, Koth and Urabrask invade the inner spheres but are defeated at the Fair Basilica; Elspeth bursts from the Blind Eternities to save them.
timeline.quote: the newly anointed archangel Elspeth burst from the Blind Eternities, giving the planeswalkers time to escape

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias builds Tezzeret a darksteel body then binds him, revealing he knew of Tezzeret's and Urabrask's intentions; a scrapchief attacks him and Tezzeret escapes.
timeline.quote: The praetor slew the scrapchief, but Tezzeret escaped before he could be further experimented upon.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn gains influence, conquering Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains.
timeline.quote: Slowly, Elesh Norn gained more influence, even in the furnace layers, effectively conquering Urabrask 's and Sheoldred 's domains.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask's red-aligned Phyrexian faction allows Mirrodin's citizens safe harbor.
timeline.quote: Its red-aligned faction, led by Urabrask, turns a blind eye to the citizens of Mirrodin, allowing them safe harbor.

citation.text: "Mirrodin". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Factionalizing and the Castes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn took control over the domains of Urabask and Sheoldred

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Domination of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask obtains Halo through Vivien Reid.
timeline.quote: Urabrask would establish contact with the planeswalker Vivien Reid and would obtain Halo , a substance that harms Phyrexians.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask starts a rebellion against Norn.
timeline.quote: Urabrask started a rebellion against Norn's Phyrexia.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After conquering Mirrodin, Elesh Norn starts a civil war against the other praetors and emerges as sole power above New Phyrexia, evolving the Machine Orthodoxy into the Machine Legion.
timeline.quote: Emerging as the Mother of Machines and sole power above all of New Phyrexia

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask conspires with Tezzeret against Norn, goes to New Capenna, obtains Halo and tasks Vivien Reid with finding Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Urabrask conspired with Tezzeret

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Urabrask on Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask refuses to take part in the invasion, so the Furnace Host is unled.
timeline.quote: Urabrask refused to participate in the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain, leaving Urabrask the only living praetor.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain, leaving Urabrask as the only living praetor

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Furnace Host is turned loose on the Multiverse because Urabrask refuses to participate.
timeline.quote: Urabrask's refusal to participate in the invasion

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret transports Urabrask to New Capenna, leaving him badly wounded.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to transport Urabrask to New Capenna

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred moves against Elesh Norn and allies with Urabrask's rebellion; Norn declares her an apostate and Ajani captures her.
timeline.quote: Norn declared her an apostate, and she was later captured by Ajani.

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad toils in the Salvage Complex managing waste disposal for Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urabrask sent obsolete Phyrexians to him for repurposing.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seeking a new body, Tezzeret allies with New Phyrexia while secretly backing Urabrask and alerting the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: he simultaneously supported the rebel praetor Urabrask and discreetly alerted the Gatewatch through trusted intermediaries

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret intercepts Vivien Reid on New Capenna to introduce her to Urabrask.
timeline.quote: he intercepted Vivien Reid

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia conquers Mirrodin, Urabrask lets Mirran survivors take refuge in the Furnace Layer and seals it from other factions.
timeline.quote: Urabrask allowed the Mirran survivors to take refuge in the Furnace Layer of the plane

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Urabrask's domain; the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters and Urabrask's red Phyrexians dwell in the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Inevitably, Elesh Norn laid waste to his domain

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret transports Urabrask to New Capenna; the Planar Bridge badly damages the praetor.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge heavily damaged the praetor's body

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask meets Vivien Reid and tasks her with bringing him Halo and Elspeth Tirel.
timeline.quote: the praetor met with Vivien Reid and tasked her with bringing him Halo and the Planeswalker Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask returns to New Phyrexia and openly rebels against Elesh Norn with his Phyrexian faction.
timeline.quote: openly fought against Elesh Norn

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask helps Chandra and Wrenn and a Mirran squadron reach Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Urabrask helped Chandra and Wrenn

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask is captured and Elesh Norn orders his execution by quartering; he is reduced to a limbless torso and possibly dies.
timeline.quote: the Grand Cenobite ordered his execution by quartering

citation.text: "Urabrask", section "Possible death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On New Capenna Vivien meets Tezzeret and then the wounded Urabrask, who tasks her with meeting Elspeth at the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: who tasked her with meeting Elspeth at the Crescendo .

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven meet Koth and Urabrask on New Phyrexia and are led to Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Traveling to New Phyrexia, Chandra, Wrenn, and Seven met with Koth and Urabrask

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "New Phyrexia's invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
